steps.title: Create a Marketplace app, user-managed first
steps.detail: In the Zoom App Marketplace, go to Develop, Build App, and create an OAuth app. Choose User-managed app for a user level app. Admin-managed is for admin scopes only.
steps.blockerTip: User-managed apps can only request scopes for an individual user's data. Admin scopes need an admin-managed app and an account admin.

steps.title: Set the Redirect URL for OAuth and allow list
steps.detail: Set Redirect URL for OAuth to your exact callback URL, and add the same URL to the allow list. Use https and a fully qualified domain, not localhost for production.
steps.blockerTip: Zoom checks the allow list against the Redirect URL. A URL in one place but not the other can fail.

steps.title: Add scopes, with a reason for each
steps.detail: Add scopes in the Scopes tab, minimum only, for example meeting:read or user:read for the feature you need. New apps use granular scopes. Write a scope description for each scope.
steps.blockerTip: Missing scope descriptions can cause rejection at publish. Do not add scopes you cannot justify.

steps.title: Get client ID and secret, and test in development
steps.detail: Copy Client ID and Client secret from App Credentials. Store the secret server side. In development mode, add test users and test OAuth with one API call.
steps.blockerTip: Development mode is limited to specified users and needs no Zoom review. Production needs publish review.

steps.title: Publish only if you need public distribution
steps.detail: For public distribution, switch to production, complete submission details, and submit for Zoom Marketplace review. Do not promise a publish date until review is done.
steps.blockerTip: Publishing is separate from creation. A development app does not become public by itself.
